versionInformation.promotionalText: Mix by touch or connect your controller. Shape every blend with layered waveforms, beat grids, loops, EQ and effects. Explore mappings for 415 hardware models.
versionInformation.description:
Mix from your own music library on iPhone, iPhone Duo, iPad or Mac. Move between a focused deck view and a wider workspace. Bring the browser, EQ and effects into view when you need them.

MIX DIRECTLY ON THE WAVEFORM
Read the beat grid and track sections at a glance. Jump by beats, set cues and use Sync to line up decks. On a touch screen, move or resize a loop with two fingers. Shape a blend with EQ, filters and effects. On a wide iPad or Mac workspace, enable four decks from Settings.

CONNECT YOUR HARDWARE
GenErik DJ includes mappings for 415 controller, mixer, player and accessory models across 49 manufacturers. Depending on the model, use hardware controls for playback, cues, loops, mixer levels, EQ or browsing. Check the controller catalogue for the mapping type and connection for your model.
https://dj.generik.au/controllers

PREPARE YOUR NEXT TRACK
Browse local songs and playlists, check BPM and key, and use recommendations to find a compatible track. Review and adjust the beat grid before your set. Audio analysis runs on the device. When iCloud is available, preparation can sync through your private iCloud storage.

RECORD YOUR SET
Save a mix, review its track history and share the recording from the app. GenErik DJ plays local, unprotected audio files from your own library.

ACCESS AND PURCHASES
Try all features for 14 days. The preview ends without starting a paid subscription. Choose monthly or lifetime access for Controller Support, Recording or Open Format. All-in-One Lifetime includes all three. Lifetime purchases also let you add your DJ name and logo inside the app.

After the preview, free use includes up to 20 minutes of controller use, 20 minutes of recording and 70 minutes of playback starts per set. Reaching a limit lets current audio continue. Monthly plans renew until canceled. See prices in the app before purchase.

review.notes:
GenErik DJ mixes local, unprotected audio from the user's own library. No app account is required.

To exercise the app, use a device with a local music library or import unprotected audio from Settings > Library. Load a song to each deck. Use the waveform to set a loop and open the deck panels to try EQ and effects. On iPhone Duo, the closed display focuses on one deck and the open display provides the wider workspace. To try four decks on a wide iPad or Mac workspace, enable Four decks in Settings.

A controller is optional for on-screen mixing. The model catalogue lists mapping types and connections at https://dj.generik.au/controllers.

The app analyzes audio on the device and uses private iCloud storage for preparation sync. The app starts with a 14-day preview and shows subscription and lifetime offers under Settings.
